description: This file defines the SchemaCompatibilityChecker class used for verifying compatibility between two component schemas in Drupal, ensuring safe component replacement by checking required properties and shared property types.

classes.name: SchemaCompatibilityChecker
classes.description: A class that provides methods to check compatibility between two component schemas in Drupal.

methods.name: isCompatible
methods.description: Checks if the new schema is compatible with the original schema, throwing an exception if not.

methods.name: checkRequired
methods.description: Verifies that required properties in the original schema are present and not improperly added in the new schema.

methods.name: checkSharedProperties
methods.description: Ensures shared properties between schemas have compatible types and enums, including nested sub-schema checks.
